text: Grandson, 7. Temperature 38.2. Says his ear hurts and he keeps pulling at it. His eczema is flaring up too, dry and itchy patches on his arms, he won't stop scratching. Breathing is fine. His lips went blue a while ago but that was the blue raspberry ice lolly he'd just eaten, it wiped off with a cloth. Do I take him somewhere tonight or call the GP in the morning?
